title: Bright 1BR Walk to Cal Poly
address: 1420 N Chorro St, Apt 2, San Luis Obispo, CA 93405
description_and_lease_text: Updated 1-bedroom apartment just 0.7 miles from Cal Poly campus. Water, sewer, and trash included in rent; tenant pays electricity/gas and internet. Includes one free off-street parking space. Features in-unit washer/dryer, dishwasher, air conditioning, and a small private patio. Subleasing allowed for summer quarter with written landlord approval. Small pets welcome with $250 refundable deposit.
